benchmarkCaveats: Figures are Tencent-reported results, not independently reproduced by TOKRACE.
Benchmark-name asterisks indicate first evaluation upon release; model-cell asterisks in the appendix indicate Tencent testing.
OSWorld 2.1 uses Full, partial score; 78.9 must not be described as a full-task completion percentage.
Model comparisons use the highest available reasoning setting; harnesses, budgets and judge systems vary as detailed in the appendix.
Hy4 Preview scores may differ from earlier releases after evaluation-harness, judge-model and anti-hacking updates.
